title: Revision journal
description: data/journal.json -- the report's revision journal as the export writes it, read by lib/calc-engine.typ (journal-entries, show-journal, docs/domain/journal.md §3.3terdecies). The entries are the source's, **sorted newest first** by their index, and nothing else: a journal is a list of what the engineer wrote, not a calculation, so there is deliberately no {vars, steps, checks} record here and nothing addresses one with show-calc. The report therefore never sorts: entries.first() is the latest revision, which is also the one the PDF's keywords name (data/project.json's `revision`).

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a record written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

entries.description: The revisions, newest first (the largest index first). Every field is a string but the index, so the display layer never has to ask what it was given; `summary` and `description` are "" where the entry carries none.

index.description: The revision's number, what the report prints as «Rev. 3» and what this list is ordered by.

date.description: The day of the revision, ISO ("2026-09-27"): what the report formats for its own language.

label.description: The engineer's own words: printed at every level, and never translated.

summary.description: "" where the entry carries none, so level 2 prints the label alone.
